newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Gas Natural 1996 gp net profit up 35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Gas Natural 1996 gp net profit up 35 pct.

text.p: NOTE: Gas Natural said net turnover was above 330 billion pesetas, rising 15 percent from the previous year.
Gas Natural said strong results were due to a six percent rise in average consumption per client after a cold winter, as well as a continual increase in the number of customers.
At year-end total group customers numbered 3.6 million, up 200,000.
Sales totalled 116 billion therms, up 10 percent.
Total group assets were 900 billion pesetas, up 51 percent, including an asset revaluation for 105 billion pesetas.
Sales were 93 billion therms in Spain, up 13 percent, and 23 billion therms in Argentina, up one percent.
Domestic-commercial sales in Spain were up 19 percent, while on the industrial side, sales rose 14 percent.
Group investment was 145 billion pesetas, up 38 percent and mainly financing the Algeria-Spain gas pipeline, as well as improvements in the distribution network.
